units.source_text: 绉纱产地离这个温泉浴场很近。

en.t: The crepe-producing area is very close to this hot spring resort.

units.source_text: 它就在山峡渐渐开阔的河流下游的原野上，因此从岛村的房间也可以望见。

en.t: It lay on the plain downstream from the river where the mountain gorge gradually opened out, and so it could also be seen from Shimamura's room.

units.source_text: 昔日建有绉纱市场的镇子，如今却修了火车站，成为闻名于世的纺织工业区。

en.t: The towns where crepe markets once stood now have railway stations and have become textile manufacturing districts known throughout the world.
